title: Estagiário(a) de engenharia de produto
description:
Nova vaga disponível para Estagiário(a) de engenharia de produto em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

JOB MISSION  The Product Engineering Intern at HwIT plays a key operational role in supporting the integrity, organization, and standardization of our product data. Working closely with Product Engineers and RD designers, the intern will act as the operational engine for Component Lifecycle Management (CLM). The mission is to clean up Bills of Materials (BOMs) for the critical projects, maintain structural databases in product system, track engineering changes, and support operational transition from prototypes to scalable production.  SCOPE  RESPONSIBILITIES  1.  BOM Scrub       Gap Analysis Support: Inspect raw BOMs extracted from RD to identify missing data, generic descriptions, or incomplete Manufacturer Part Numbers (MPNs). Interface actively with developers to obtain commercial part numbers and technical specifications for empty fields.       BOM Versioning: Maintain structured control with clean, complete baselines for projects in the Alpha and Beta development phases.  2.  Product Traceability and Versioning       System Data Entry: Register newly approved electronic and optical components (MPNs) in the database, ensuring complete description, manufacturer name, unit, and fiscal data (NCM).       BOM Tree Assembly: Input multi-level BOM structures for active projects in product system, linking components to their respective designators and quantities.       JIRA Workflow Management: Register and update Engineering Change Notice (ECN) and Supplier PCN tickets in Jira, moving them through the workflow and ensuring all required fields are filled.       Confluence Documentation: Update product documentation and maintain versioning control.    3. Inventory, Assembly Process  Capacity Support       Inventory Auditing: Perform physical-to-system stock level audits for components, correcting entries in system.       Assembly Documentation Support: Support the documentation of assembly processes, assisting in the creation and revision of work instructions (WI), assembly flowcharts, and process layouts.       Capacity  Flow Analysis: Assist in analyzing assembly process flows and tracking capacity metrics, including cycle times, process step yields, and bottleneck identification.       Engineering Feedback: Support regular time studies and audits on pilot assembly lines to gather real process times and yields, using this data to feed back and engineering and product models. Assist in collecting data from pilot line assembly runs, tracking component issues, and collecting feedback from operators.       Troubleshooting: Support troubleshooting and yields improvement action plans in pilot lines, as well as inputs for PFMEA, Waterfall charts, and 8D reports.   ?  CANDIDATE PROFILE Education  Background  Essential:       Currently pursuing a Bachelors Degree in Electronic, Electrical, Mechatronic, Telecommunications, or Production Engineering (preferably from the 4th semester onwards).       Availability to work 6 hours per day (30 hours/week) in an office model.  Technical Requirements       Excel: advanced level (VLOOKUP, Pivot Tables, logical formulas).       Atlassian: Familiarity with Jira and Confluence is a plus.       Electronics: Eagerness to learn about electronic components, packages, and hardware design tools       Data Analysis Automation: Python and SQL are desirable.   Languages       Portuguese: Native or Bilingual.       English: Intermediate to Upper-Intermediate (B1/B2 level  reading datasheets and writing technical specifications is required).  Soft Skills (Aligned with HwIT Values)       Superar (Overcome - Proactivity): Self-starter attitude; comfortable reaching out to busy engineers to chase information and unblock tasks (the  desenrolado  profile).       Inovar (Innovate - Continuous Improvement): Sharp eye to detect anomalies in assembly flows and capacity models, proposing creative adjustments during pilot line audits to improve process efficiency and yield forecasting.  Desenvolver (Develop - Organization): Ability to manage lists, documents, and spreadsheets systematically.

Conduzir treinamentos contínuos para a equipe, abordando temas como atendimento ao cliente, técnicas de vendas, uso de sistemas, indicadores de desempenho e normas operacionais. Atuar como referência técnica e comportamental, promovendo engajamento, disciplina operacional e foco em resultados. title: Auxiliar de logística i
description:

O Auxiliar de Logística I é responsável por garantir a eficiência nas operações logísticas, realizando atividades como o recebimento e verificação de mercadorias, registrando entradas no sistema e organizando o armazenamento dos produtos. VALORES:   Valorizar e desenvolver os colaboradores;  Buscar sistematicamente a eficácia dos processos de trabalho;  Oferecer produtos de excelente relação custo-benefício ao cliente;  Respeitar os padrões éticos nas questões internas, externas e concorrências.    Requisitos  1) Experiência:  - Desejável experiência anterior em atividades logísticas ou em armazéns é desejável, mas não obrigatória.    1. Recebimento de Mercadorias  - Conferir os equipamentos, garantindo que a quantidade e a qualidade estejam de acordo com as especificações do pedido e notas fiscais.  - Registrar as entradas de produtos no sistema de controle de estoque, garantindo a precisão das informações e a atualização em tempo real.  - Manter toda a documentação relacionada ao recebimento de mercadorias organizada e acessível para futuras consultas.    2. Armazenamento  - Classificar e armazenar os produtos em locais designados, seguindo o sistema de endereçamento do armazém para facilitar o acesso e a localização.  - Monitorar prazos de validade de produtos, e notificar supervisores sobre itens que precisam ser rotacionados.  - Garantir que as áreas de armazenamento estejam limpas e organizadas, contribuindo para a segurança e eficiência operacional.    3. Expedição  - Separar e preparar os pedidos para expedição, garantindo que todos os itens estejam corretos e em boas condições.  - Verificar a precisão das informações na documentação de expedição, conferindo o conteúdo dos pedidos com as notas fiscais antes do envio.  - Auxiliar no carregamento e descarregamento de veículos de transporte, utilizando equipamentos adequados (como paleteiras e empilhadeiras) quando necessário.    4. Controle de Estoque  - Acompanhar os níveis de estoque, alertando supervisores sobre a necessidade de reposição de produtos e evitando faltas.  - Participar da realização de inventários periódicos, ajudando a contar e registrar a quantidade de produtos em estoque para assegurar a precisão dos dados.  - Identificar e relatar quaisquer discrepâncias entre os registros de estoque e a contagem física de mercadorias.    5. Documentação e Relatórios  - Auxiliar na elaboração de relatórios sobre a movimentação de mercadorias, incluindo entradas, saídas e nível de estoque.  - Manter os registros de movimentação de mercadorias atualizados e organizados, facilitando o acesso às informações por parte da equipe e supervisores.  - Registrar e relatar qualquer anomalia ou problema identificado durante as operações logísticas.    6. Suporte à Equipe  - Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com outros membros da equipe logística, oferecendo suporte nas atividades diárias e compartilhando informações relevantes.  -Participar de reuniões de equipe e treinamentos, contribuindo com ideias e feedbacks para melhorias nos processos logísticos.  - Auxiliar em projetos específicos de melhoria logística, como reorganização do espaço de armazenamento ou implementação de novos processos.

description:

PURPOSE OF THE POSITION:    The Consolidation Specialist contributes to the production of Imerys' quarterly consolidated financial statements in accordance with IFRS standards, by overseeing the financial statements of the Americas subsidiaries with the Americas Consolidation Manager, and producing Group analyses in coordination with the Group Consolidation team (totalling 9 people), spread across Paris, Brussels, Singapore, and Campinas, covering overall a scope of approximately 220 entities spread across some fifty countries.   The Consolidation Specialist also collaborates closely with the administration team of the SAP FC consolidation software, as well as other departments within Finance (Reporting, Tax, Treasury), both in Brazil and abroad.    KEY TASKS AND RESPONSIBILITIES:     Quarterly package review    - Supervise the correct and timely completion of quarterly reporting packages in SAP FC for the Americas scope.  - Analyze balance sheets and variances, equity analyses, tax reviews, and reconciliation of intercompany transactions.  - Ensure the resolution of blocking control and support reporting units with technical queries throughout the closing process.  - Ensure that the consolidated accounts of entities in the region comply with IFRS standards and Group policies.  - Establish, manage, and communicate reporting schedules and closing deadlines for the region.    Group analyses    - Contribute to global Group topics, including IFRS 16 (Leases) reviews, mining accounting issues, and other specific key performance indicators.    One-off items    - Assist units in preparing for quarterly closings by anticipating the IFRS treatment of specific transactions according to the Group accounting manual.  - Support Mergers & Acquisitions (M&A), divestitures, or internal mergers within the Americas scope.  - Define solutions to improve processes, reporting timelines, and the reliability of consolidated data.    OTHER IMPORTANT FUNCTIONS:    The position includes regular discussions with external auditors regarding the Americas scope and assistance with internal audit requirements. Previous experience in auditing is highly desirable.    REQUIREMENTS:    Education:   Bachelor’s degree in Accounting (Certified Accountant).   Experience:   Minimum of 5 to 7 years in accounting, with a strong focus on consolidation and external auditing.   Languages:   Fluent English (mandatory for writing and speaking) and advanced Spanish (desirable).    Know-how, skills, abilities and other characteristics:     Technical Skills:   Proficiency in Google and Microsoft applications (especially Excel); experience with financial software and databases such as SAP BFC (reporting tool - desirable), SAP 4HANA (desirable) and Anaplan (desirable).   Soft Skills:   Team player, ability to build trust-based relationships with peers and international contacts, and focus on continuous improvement.   Essential Qualities:   Organized, strict adherence to deadlines, analytical mindset, autonomy, transparency, and a proactive attitude toward learning.    In commitment to Diversity, Equity and Inclusion, this opportunity is also aimed at candidates with disabilities.

title: Data Engineer
description:
Empresa está contratando Data Engineer em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

GEA is one of the world’s largest systems suppliers for the food, beverage and pharmaceutical sectors. Our portfolio includes machinery and plants as well as advanced process technology, components and comprehensive services. Used across diverse industries, they enhance the sustainability and efficiency of production processes globally.   We are looking for a Data Engineer    Roles And Responsibilities     Data Architecture & Infrastructure    Design and implement a unified data warehouse and/or data lake capable of serving multiple analytics and AI workloads.   Define the overall data architecture strategy, including storage layers, access patterns, and scalability approach.   Define the data extraction and landing strategy, partitioning and SCD (slowly changing dimensions), data modelling strategy and consumption ports.     Pipeline Development & Integration    Build and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines consuming data from multiple enterprise source systems (ERP, CRM, operational tools, and others).   Develop pipelines using Databricks (Lakeflow Connect) & Azure Data Factory as primary platforms.   Ensure pipeline reliability, scalability, and observability through monitoring, alerting, and logging.     Data Quality & Governance    Establish and enforce data quality standards, validation rules, and anomaly detection processes.   Implement data cataloguing, lineage tracking, and documentation practices to ensure transparency and auditability.   Define naming conventions, schema standards, and access control policies in coordination with stakeholders.     Collaboration & Stakeholder Engagement    Work closely with data scientists, BI analysts, and developers within the team to ensure data products meet downstream requirements.   Translate business requirements from non-technical stakeholders into robust data models and pipeline logic.   Actively contribute to sprint planning and technical decision-making within an agile team environment.     Continuous Improvement    Monitor and optimize query performance, pipeline efficiency, and infrastructure cost.   Stay current with developments in data engineering tooling, cloud platforms, and best practices.   Contribute to the team's knowledge base through documentation and internal knowledge-sharing.     Profile And Qualifications     Minimum 5 years of professional experience in data engineering or a closely related field.   Expert-level proficiency in SQL — including complex query design, performance tuning, and schema modeling.   Hands-on experience with Databricks for large-scale data processing and pipeline orchestration.   Proven experience designing and implementing data warehouse or data lake solutions at enterprise scale.   Strong understanding of ETL/ELT design patterns, data modeling methodologies (star schema, data vault, etc.), and pipeline orchestration.   Experience integrating data from heterogeneous source systems (ERP platforms, APIs, flat files, operational databases).   Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.   Professional-level proficiency in Spanish; working English is a strong advantage.

Sua agenda? Já vem prontinha, nosso sistema qualifica e agenda para você. Os leads? Atraidos pelo nosso marketing irresistível.  Você só faz o que sabe fazer de melhor: vender. O dia que uma mãe de 35 realizou um sonho antigo. A virada de chave de um jovem que sempre quis, mas nunca soube como.  Cada venda sua vira um novo nome nos créditos finais de uma série. Cada contrato fechado pode ser o "antes e depois" de alguém. Confiou em você? Contrato fechado....    Seu trabalho é converter. E ganhar bem com isso.    SOBRE NÓS     LikePlay Filmes não é só produtora, é movimento. Já dirigimos mais de 7 mil atores, distribuímos conteúdo em plataformas gigantes e criamos um ecossistema completo pra quem quer viver de audiovisual no Brasil.    Somos a empresa que democratiza o acesso ao cinema. E precisamos de gente que venda isso com a mesma garra que a gente produz.    LUZES, CÂMERA, CARREIRA!    Se você tem fome de resultado, gosta de desafios e quer trabalhar num lugar onde  cada venda realmente importa   , essa vaga é sua. Não é só mais um trabalho comum. É a chance de ser lembrado como a pessoa que ajudou alguém a realizar um sonho.    Candidata-se agora e vem fazer parte dessa história.

description:

Welcome to the realm of innovation as our next DevOps Engineer, where you'll be leading the charge in revolutionizing our DevOps initiatives. This role isn't just about managing infrastructure; it's about pushing boundaries and propelling us into the future. Get ready to architect cutting-edge solutions, mentor budding talents, and infuse innovation into our deployment processes. Armed with your expertise in automation, cloud services, and system administration, you'll be instrumental in shaping the future of our technological landscape. If you're passionate about driving change and leaving a lasting impact, this is the role for you.   What Will I Do?    What will my main tasks be?  You'll strategically develop and maintain advanced CI/CD pipelines, integrating the latest tools and techniques to streamline our deployment processes.    How will I contribute to the team?  Your role is pivotal in architecting and managing robust, scalable cloud infrastructure solutions, harnessing the power of cutting-edge cloud services to propel us forward.    Will I collaborate with other departments?  Absolutely! You'll work closely with product owners and client services to ensure our solutions resonate with our clients and meet their evolving needs.    What methodologies will I be using?  You'll embrace Agile methodologies, ensuring our projects are executed efficiently and effectively, driving innovation and continuous improvement.    Are You the Right Fit?    Do you have extensive experience with DevOps?  We're seeking candidates with over 5 years of hands-on experience in the DevOps realm, ready to take on the next challenge.    How familiar are you with coding best practices?  Proficiency in SOLID and clean coding principles, especially in the context of scalable solutions, is a must-have for this role.    What's your experience with code reviews and automated testing?  We're looking for candidates with extensive experience in conducting code reviews, writing automated tests, and implementing CI/CD pipelines, leveraging a variety of programming languages.    Can you demonstrate expertise in testing?  Strong expertise in both unit testing and integration testing is essential, with a focus on maintaining high code coverage to ensure the reliability of our software solutions.    How do you approach technical decision-making?  We're seeking someone who can make informed technical decisions and tailor approaches to suit each unique use case, driving innovation and efficiency.    What is your level of knowledge in IT infrastructure?  A solid understanding of IT infrastructure is crucial for this role, ensuring our systems are robust, scalable, and secure.    Is your English proficiency at an advanced level?  Advanced proficiency in English is essential for effective communication in our global environment, fostering collaboration and understanding across teams.    Are you located in Argentina?  Candidates must reside in Argentina to be eligible for this position.    What Would Be a Plus?    Do you have experience with CI/CD tools like Jenkins, GitLab, or CircleCI?  Experience with these tools will give you a head start in tackling our DevOps challenges.    Are you well-versed in system security principles?  A strong understanding of system security and the ability to implement and manage robust security policies for cloud-based systems will be highly valued in this role.    Are you available to work on call when needed?  Availability to work on call demonstrates your commitment to ensuring the smooth operation of our systems, even during critical times. Competitive Compensation: Choose between compensation options in USD or your local currency, tailored to your financial preferences. Comprehensive Leave: Take advantage of paid parental leave, vacation time, and observed national holidays.   Cultural Diversity: Immerse yourself in a multicultural workplace that celebrates innovation and creativity.   Elite Teamwork: Collaborate with top industry professionals, learning and growing with the best.   Career Support: Benefit from a nurturing environment focused on mentorship, skill development, and varied growth opportunities.

Olá, futuro(a) Product Owner (Pleno/Sênior)!    Estamos em busca de um Product Owner com perfil Builder. Mais do que organizar tarefas, você será o responsável por estruturar a solução. Seja concebendo um produto inédito ou modernizando um fluxo operacional, sua missão é garantir que cada decisão técnica e de negócio tenha um propósito claro. Você atuará na intersecção entre estratégia, processos e tecnologia, impulsionando a entrega de valor real.    Onde você vai jogar (Time e Estrutura):    Você fará parte de uma estrutura robusta e colaborativa. Não atuará isolado(a), mas sim como peça central de uma célula multidisciplinar composta por:   Time de UX/Design: Para garantir fluidez e usabilidade.   Squad de Desenvolvimento & QA: Engenheiros focados em performance e qualidade.   Especialistas de Negócio: Stakeholders com profundo conhecimento de mercado, com os quais você trocará experiências diariamente para desenhar a melhor solução.     Seus Desafios e Responsabilidades:   1. Concepção e Estratégia (Foco em Resultado)  Mentalidade de Construção: Liderar a descoberta de produtos, realizando benchmarking e pesquisas para identificar oportunidades reais, seja em novos mercados ou na otimização interna.   Decisão Baseada em Fatos: Eliminar o "achismo". Utilizar dados e evidências para validar se estamos resolvendo o problema certo antes de iniciar o desenvolvimento.   Entrega Incremental (MVP): Definir a primeira versão do produto com assertividade. O objetivo não é criar softwares complexos que demoram meses para sair do papel, mas entregar valor rápido e iterar com base no uso real.  2. Engenharia de Processos e Lógica   Mapeamento de Cenários (As Is / To Be): Mergulhar na operação para entender o cenário atual e projetar o processo futuro otimizado. O software deve ser o reflexo de um processo inteligente.   Raciocínio Lógico: Mapear fluxos condicionais e regras de decisão (ex: "Se Cliente A, então Ação B"), traduzindo a complexidade do negócio em diagramas visuais que tragam clareza absoluta para o time técnico.  3. Especificação Técnica e PRD (Product Requirements Document)  Documentação Precisa: Criar PRDs que funcionem como a "fonte da verdade", contendo fluxogramas, regras de negócio e critérios de aceite detalhados para eliminar dúvidas durante o desenvolvimento.   Wireframing e Prototipação Básica: Para demandas de menor complexidade ou validações rápidas de fluxo, você deve ter autonomia para desenhar wireframes ou mockups funcionais.   Lógica de Dados: Estruturar logicamente quais dados, filtros e critérios são necessários para a construção de relatórios e telas, facilitando o trabalho da engenharia.    Requisitos (O que buscamos em você):    Perfil Realizador (Builder): Histórico comprovado na construção e lançamento de produtos ou funcionalidades relevantes.   Raciocínio Lógico Estruturado: Facilidade para quebrar problemas grandes em etapas menores, sequenciais e lógicas.   Habilidade com Fluxogramas: Experiência em desenhar processos de forma visual (BPMN ou fluxos livres).   Escrita Técnica de Excelência: Capacidade de detalhar requisitos cobrindo cenários de sucesso, erro e exceção com clareza impecável.   Autonomia em Prototipação: Conforto em rabiscar interfaces funcionais para tangibilizar ideias.   Comunicação Articulada: Habilidade de transitar entre o time técnico e os especialistas de negócio com fluidez, garantindo alinhamento total.    Diferencial Competitivo    IA como Copiloto: Buscamos profissionais que já incorporaram a Inteligência Artificial no seu fluxo de trabalho diário. Valorizamos quem sabe utilizar a IA como um parceiro intelectual e alavanca de produtividade — seja para estruturar cenários, refinar documentações, gerar insights de dados ou acelerar o dia a dia. title: Analista de dados
description:

Analista de Dados — Perfil e Risco    Sobre a Cooperlink A Cooperlink é uma associação de proteção patrimonial mutualista que atua na proteção veicular, oferecendo aos seus associados um modelo cooperativo de rateio de prejuízos como alternativa ao seguro tradicional. Operamos com tecnologia própria, integração direta entre CRM, sistema de gestão e canais de atendimento, e uma cultura orientada a dados — onde cada decisão de produto, comercial e operacional passa pela análise de carteira, perfil de associado e exposição a risco. Nosso time de dados atua de forma transversal, com acesso direto à diretoria e impacto real nas definições estratégicas da cooperativa.   Resumo da posição Profissional responsável por transformar dados de associados/segurados, apólices, sinistros e canais em análises que orientem decisões de subscrição, pricing, retenção e mitigação de risco. Atua como ponte entre as áreas técnica, comercial e operacional, traduzindo comportamento e exposição em indicadores acionáveis.    Principais responsabilidades    Construir e manter análises de perfil de carteira (associados, veículos, regiões, canais) identificando padrões de comportamento, consumo e propensão a sinistro.   Desenvolver indicadores de risco: sinistralidade, frequência, severidade, prêmio médio, índice combinado e desvios por segmento.   Apoiar a área de subscrição/underwriting com estudos de aceitação, recusa e precificação por faixa de risco.   Realizar análises de churn, inadimplência e propensão à renovação, propondo ações de retenção baseadas em dados.   Estruturar segmentações de carteira (clusterização por perfil de risco, ticket, vínculo, geografia).   Monitorar carteira ativa: alertas de deterioração de sinistralidade, concentração de risco e desvios de meta.   Construir dashboards executivos e operacionais em Power BI (ou equivalente) com camada semântica bem modelada.   Criar e manter pipelines de dados em parceria com engenharia de dados, garantindo qualidade, consistência e rastreabilidade.   Documentar regras de negócio, dicionário de dados e metodologias de cálculo dos indicadores de risco.   Atender demandas ad hoc de diretoria, atuária, comercial e financeiro com agilidade e clareza.     Requisitos obrigatórios    Experiência mínima de 3 anos como Analista de Dados/BI, sendo pelo menos 1 ano no mercado segurador, de proteção patrimonial mutualista, saúde, previdência ou crédito.   SQL avançado (joins complexos, CTEs, window functions, otimização de consultas).   Power BI avançado: modelagem em estrela, DAX (medidas, time intelligence, variáveis), Power Query/M.   Excel avançado, incluindo Power Query e estruturação de relatórios analíticos.   Familiaridade com indicadores de seguro: sinistralidade, prêmio médio, frequência, severidade, índice combinado, LTV, CAC.   Conhecimento de segmentação, análise de coorte e fundamentos de estatística descritiva.   Boa comunicação para apresentar análises a públicos técnicos e não técnicos.     Diferenciais    Python (pandas, numpy, scikit-learn) ou R para análises estatísticas e modelos preditivos.   Experiência com Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, BigQuery ou Snowflake.   Vivência em modelos de propensão (churn, sinistro, fraude) ou clusterização (K-Means, DBSCAN).   Conhecimento de LGPD aplicado a dados sensíveis de clientes.   Familiaridade com APIs de sistemas de gestão securitária (Hinova/SGA, Tex, Quiver, Sami) ou CRMs do setor.   Noções de atuária básica e cálculo de provisões.   Experiência com Git e versionamento de relatórios/scripts.     Perfil comportamental    Autonomia para investigar problemas de dados sem precisar de roteiro.   Pensamento crítico — questiona o número antes de entregar.   Postura consultiva: traduz pergunta de negócio em análise, não espera escopo pronto.   Organização para lidar com múltiplas demandas simultâneas.     Benefícios   (Salário compatível com senioridade · VR/VA · Plano de Saúde · TotalPass · Bolsa e Auxílio Educação)

A strong understanding of system security and the ability to implement and manage robust security policies for cloud-based systems will be highly valued in this role. Are you available to work on call when needed? Availability to work on call demonstrates your commitment to ensuring the smooth operation of our systems, even during critical times. title: Data Engineer
description:
Empresa está contratando Data Engineer em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

GEA is one of the world’s largest systems suppliers for the food, beverage and pharmaceutical sectors. Our portfolio includes machinery and plants as well as advanced process technology, components and comprehensive services. Used across diverse industries, they enhance the sustainability and efficiency of production processes globally. We are looking for a Data Engineer Roles And Responsibilities  Data Architecture & Infrastructure  Design and implement a unified data warehouse and/or data lake capable of serving multiple analytics and AI workloads. Define the overall data architecture strategy, including storage layers, access patterns, and scalability approach. Define the data extraction and landing strategy, partitioning and SCD (slowly changing dimensions), data modelling strategy and consumption ports.  Pipeline Development & Integration  Build and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines consuming data from multiple enterprise source systems (ERP, CRM, operational tools, and others). Develop pipelines using Databricks (Lakeflow Connect) & Azure Data Factory as primary platforms. Ensure pipeline reliability, scalability, and observability through monitoring, alerting, and logging.  Data Quality & Governance  Establish and enforce data quality standards, validation rules, and anomaly detection processes. Implement data cataloguing, lineage tracking, and documentation practices to ensure transparency and auditability. Define naming conventions, schema standards, and access control policies in coordination with stakeholders.  Collaboration & Stakeholder Engagement  Work closely with data scientists, BI analysts, and developers within the team to ensure data products meet downstream requirements. Translate business requirements from non-technical stakeholders into robust data models and pipeline logic. Actively contribute to sprint planning and technical decision-making within an agile team environment.  Continuous Improvement  Monitor and optimize query performance, pipeline efficiency, and infrastructure cost. Stay current with developments in data engineering tooling, cloud platforms, and best practices. Contribute to the team's knowledge base through documentation and internal knowledge-sharing.  Profile And Qualifications  Minimum 5 years of professional experience in data engineering or a closely related field. Expert-level proficiency in SQL — including complex query design, performance tuning, and schema modeling. Hands-on experience with Databricks for large-scale data processing and pipeline orchestration. Proven experience designing and implementing data warehouse or data lake solutions at enterprise scale. Strong understanding of ETL/ELT design patterns, data modeling methodologies (star schema, data vault, etc.), and pipeline orchestration. Experience integrating data from heterogeneous source systems (ERP platforms, APIs, flat files, operational databases). Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences. Professional-level proficiency in Spanish; working English is a strong advantage.

title: Vendedor (Closer) Presencial
description:

Campinas, SP | Vaga Presencial PJ   Sabe aquele filme onde o protagonista encontra o trabalho perfeito? Pois é. Essa é sua audição. A LikePlay Filmes produz conteúdo original para Amazon Prime Video, VivoPlay, NetNow e nossa própria plataforma de streaming. Mas não paramos por aí: criamos o Zero ao Set Plus , um programa que transforma pessoas comuns em atores profissionais com participação GARANTIDA em nossas produções. E agora precisamos de você  para converter sonhadores em estrelas do cinema. SUA MISSÃO (CASO ACEITE)  Você vai atender por videochamada pessoas de todo o Brasil que sonham em ser atores. Sua agenda? Já vem prontinha, nosso sistema qualifica e agenda para você. Os leads? Atraidos pelo nosso marketing irresistível. Você só faz o que sabe fazer de melhor: vender.  O produto é simples de entender: formação em atuação para tv e cinema completa + garantia de atuar em produção real. Investimento de um Ticket médio R$3.100. E cada venda? Muda uma vida de verdade. O QUE VOCÊ GANHA?  Ajuda de custo:  Fixo R$36k/ano (R$3.000/mês), Comissões:  Somadas vão de 10% a 14% e podem triplicar ou quadruplicar  sua renda total (Nossos vendedores top faturam tranquilamente R$8k a R$15k/mês) Esquema:  Seg a sex, horário comercial, presencial em Campinas, mas com  flexibilidade REAL pra trabalhar de casa quando precisar. POR QUE ESSA VAGA É DIFERENTE?   Porque você não vai vender "mais um curso online". Vai vender o momento que uma criança, adolescente ou até mesmo um adulto vai lembrar pro resto da vida. O dia que uma mãe de 35 realizou um sonho antigo. A virada de chave de um jovem que sempre quis, mas nunca soube como. Cada venda sua vira um novo nome nos créditos finais de uma série. Cada contrato fechado pode ser o "antes e depois" de alguém.  E convenhamos: quantos vendedores podem dizer que vão dormir felizes sabendo que ajudaram alguém a aparecer nas telonas do cinema ou streamings? O QUE VOCÊ PRECISA TER?  Experiência com vendas (de preferência consultivas ou inside sales) Jogo de cintura pra negociar e fechar por videochamada Organização pra gerenciar seu funil e bater metas Comunicação afiada, você vai vender sonhos com método, não papo furado Vontade de trabalhar numa empresa descolada que está quebrando as regras do mercado tradicional Diferencial:  Conhecimento em CRM e gestão comercial Essencial:  Acreditar que dá pra vender com propósito E ganhar bem fazendo isso ESTRUTURA QUE FUNCIONA  Aqui você não fica sozinho inventando a roda: ✓ Sistema de SDR qualifica e monta sua agenda  (você não perde tempo prospectando) ✓ Marketing gera leads quentes  (gente que JÁ quer o produto) ✓ CRM organizado  (funil claro, processo definido) ✓ Produto que vende sozinho  (quando a pessoa entende, ela QUER), o maior desafio é a desconfiança. Confiou em você? Contrato fechado.... Seu trabalho é converter. E ganhar bem com isso. SOBRE NÓS  LikePlay Filmes não é só produtora, é movimento. Já dirigimos mais de 7 mil atores, distribuímos conteúdo em plataformas gigantes e criamos um ecossistema completo pra quem quer viver de audiovisual no Brasil. Somos a empresa que democratiza o acesso ao cinema. E precisamos de gente que venda isso com a mesma garra que a gente produz. LUZES, CÂMERA, CARREIRA!  Se você tem fome de resultado, gosta de desafios e quer trabalhar num lugar onde cada venda realmente importa , essa vaga é sua. Não é só mais um trabalho comum. É a chance de ser lembrado como a pessoa que ajudou alguém a realizar um sonho. Candidata-se agora e vem fazer parte dessa história.

title: Product Owner
description:
Nova vaga disponível para Product Owner em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

Olá, futuro(a) Product Owner (Pleno/Sênior)!   Estamos em busca de um Product Owner com perfil Builder. Procuramos alguém versátil, capaz de atuar em duas frentes estratégicas: tirar novas ideias do papel (Zero to One) e liderar a transformação digital de processos existentes, convertendo operações manuais ou complexas em experiências digitais fluidas. Mais do que organizar tarefas, você será o responsável por estruturar a solução. Seja concebendo um produto inédito ou modernizando um fluxo operacional, sua missão é garantir que cada decisão técnica e de negócio tenha um propósito claro. Você atuará na intersecção entre estratégia, processos e tecnologia, impulsionando a entrega de valor real. Onde você vai jogar (Time e Estrutura):  Você fará parte de uma estrutura robusta e colaborativa. Não atuará isolado(a), mas sim como peça central de uma célula multidisciplinar composta por: Time de UX/Design: Para garantir fluidez e usabilidade. Squad de Desenvolvimento & QA: Engenheiros focados em performance e qualidade. Especialistas de Negócio: Stakeholders com profundo conhecimento de mercado, com os quais você trocará experiências diariamente para desenhar a melhor solução. Seus Desafios e Responsabilidades:  1. Concepção e Estratégia (Foco em Resultado) Mentalidade de Construção: Liderar a descoberta de produtos, realizando benchmarking e pesquisas para identificar oportunidades reais, seja em novos mercados ou na otimização interna. Decisão Baseada em Fatos: Eliminar o "achismo". Utilizar dados e evidências para validar se estamos resolvendo o problema certo antes de iniciar o desenvolvimento. Entrega Incremental (MVP): Definir a primeira versão do produto com assertividade. O objetivo não é criar softwares complexos que demoram meses para sair do papel, mas entregar valor rápido e iterar com base no uso real. 2. Engenharia de Processos e Lógica Mapeamento de Cenários (As Is / To Be): Mergulhar na operação para entender o cenário atual e projetar o processo futuro otimizado. O software deve ser o reflexo de um processo inteligente. Raciocínio Lógico: Mapear fluxos condicionais e regras de decisão (ex: "Se Cliente A, então Ação B"), traduzindo a complexidade do negócio em diagramas visuais que tragam clareza absoluta para o time técnico. 3. Especificação Técnica e PRD (Product Requirements Document) Documentação Precisa: Criar PRDs que funcionem como a "fonte da verdade", contendo fluxogramas, regras de negócio e critérios de aceite detalhados para eliminar dúvidas durante o desenvolvimento. Wireframing e Prototipação Básica: Para demandas de menor complexidade ou validações rápidas de fluxo, você deve ter autonomia para desenhar wireframes ou mockups funcionais. Lógica de Dados: Estruturar logicamente quais dados, filtros e critérios são necessários para a construção de relatórios e telas, facilitando o trabalho da engenharia. Requisitos (O que buscamos em você):  Perfil Realizador (Builder): Histórico comprovado na construção e lançamento de produtos ou funcionalidades relevantes. Raciocínio Lógico Estruturado: Facilidade para quebrar problemas grandes em etapas menores, sequenciais e lógicas. Habilidade com Fluxogramas: Experiência em desenhar processos de forma visual (BPMN ou fluxos livres). Escrita Técnica de Excelência: Capacidade de detalhar requisitos cobrindo cenários de sucesso, erro e exceção com clareza impecável. Autonomia em Prototipação: Conforto em rabiscar interfaces funcionais para tangibilizar ideias. Comunicação Articulada: Habilidade de transitar entre o time técnico e os especialistas de negócio com fluidez, garantindo alinhamento total. Diferencial Competitivo  IA como Copiloto: Buscamos profissionais que já incorporaram a Inteligência Artificial no seu fluxo de trabalho diário. Valorizamos quem sabe utilizar a IA como um parceiro intelectual e alavanca de produtividade — seja para estruturar cenários, refinar documentações, gerar insights de dados ou acelerar o dia a dia. Benefícios:  Gympass Plano de Saúde Amil (Sem desconto para o titular) Plano Odontológico Uniodonto (Sem desconto para o titular) Vale-Refeição Vale-Transporte OU Auxílio Combustível Cesta Básica Convênio Farmácia Parceria com instituições de Ensino.  Informações adicionais:  Modelo de contratação:  CLT. Nível:  Pleno/Sênior. Salário:  A combinar. Horário:  Segunda à sexta, (40 horas semanais). Modelo de trabalho:  Híbrido. Local:  Sky Galleria (no Shopping Galleria) - Av. Bailarina Selma Parada, 505 - Jd. Madalena - Campinas/SP.  Estamos ansioso para te conhecer!

description:

Role Overview   Syntage is seeking an IT & Automation Manager to serve as the technical owner of our internal systems, IT infrastructure, and process automations. This role bridges the gap between business operations and technology. You will act as an internal consultant outlining high-level technical strategies, while also personally executing the hands-on development—including software integrations, AI adoption, and workflow automations. Additionally, you will manage the company's foundational cybersecurity posture and day-to-day IT administration.   Key Responsibilities   Business Process Engineering (Core Expectation)   Conduct needs assessments with department leads to identify operational bottlenecks and manual processes. Translate non-technical business requirements into actionable architectural designs and technical scopes. Act as an internal consultant, proposing ROI-driven technology implementations. Manage change adoption by providing training, documentation, and ongoing support for newly implemented tools. Automation, Integration & AI Implementation   Design, build, and maintain system integrations across our Saa S ecosystem utilizing REST APIs, webhooks, and middleware platforms (e.g., Zapier, Make, n8n) or custom scripts (Python, Java Script). Evaluate, test, and deploy AI tools to automate routine operational tasks. Administer databases and ensure data integrity as information flows between the CRM, ERP, and operational software. IT Administration & Security   Administer core software platforms and directories, including (Google Workspace / Microsoft 365). Manage the employee technology lifecycle, including hardware provisioning and onboarding/offboarding technical access. Enforce cybersecurity best practices, managing Identity and Access Management (IAM), SSO, MFA, and endpoint security. Manage IT vendor relationships, negotiate Saa S contracts, and monitor software spend to systematically prevent tool sprawl. Required Qualifications & Skills   Technical Experience:   5+ years of hybrid experience spanning IT Administration, Systems Architecture, Technical Operations, Business Process Engineering, or Software Integration. Demonstrated experience managing technology projects end-to-end within an SMB or startup environment. Strong understanding of cloud-based Saa S ecosystems, APIs, and relational data structures. High proficiency in building complex workflows using middleware (e.g., n8n, Make, Zapier) or lightweight scripting. Practical knowledge of applying AI tools to everyday business workflows. Foundational understanding of cybersecurity risk management, network security, and data privacy protocols. Soft Skills & Behavioral Competencies:   Communication: Proven ability to effectively translate business needs into technical scopes, and explain complex technical concepts and security requirements to non-technical stakeholders with patience and clarity. Critical Thinking: Strong analytical approach to problem-solving; ability to identify the root causes of operational friction rather than just treating symptoms. Decision-Making: Highly autonomous execution; capable of evaluating vendor tools, technical trade-offs, and ROI to make definitive architectural and software purchasing decisions. Benefits & Compensation   Compensation details will be discussed during the interview process.

Sua principal missão será levar a solução da Liora para pequenas e médias empresas e clientes residenciais que mais sentem o impacto da conta de luz no bolso e ainda não sabem que têm uma alternativa melhor. Conduzir o Ciclo de Vendas Completo: Apresentar propostas de valor, negociar com clareza e fechar contratos que gerem valor real para os clientes e para a Liora. Atuar como a Voz do Cliente: Trazer feedbacks valiosos do mercado para colaborar com os times de Produto, Marketing e Pós-venda, nos ajudando a melhorar continuamente.    O que Buscamos em Você: Perfil Hunter: Você tem energia, resiliência e paixão por abrir novas portas e prospectar clientes. Comunicação Excepcional: Habilidade de se comunicar de forma clara, direta e empática, criando conexões genuínas. Foco no Cliente: Uma obsessão por entender, resolver problemas e encantar quem está do outro lado da linha. Mentalidade de Dono(a): Autonomia para planejar, agilidade para executar e flexibilidade para ajustar a rota em busca dos melhores resultados. Aqui, seu resultado define seu ganho. Plano de Saúde: Subsidiado pela empresa. Seguro de Vida. Vale-Refeição/Alimentação. Vale-Transporte ou Auxílio Deslocamento.    E aí, vamos transformar o futuro da energia juntos?    Se você se identificou com a nossa missão e acredita que tem o perfil para este desafio, queremos te conhecer!     #Vem Pra Liora #Energia Simples #Transformação #Vendas Com Propósito

title: Customer success manager
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Customer success manager em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

Employment Type: Full-time position employed by a partner agency (3rd party, B2 B)   About Sisense   Sisense is a leading AI-powered Analytics Platform as a Service (An Paa S) that empowers product teams and developers to embed conversational, predictive, and agentic intelligence directly into applications and workflows. Our API-first, developer-first platform turns complex data into faster, smarter, actionable decisions for global customers across financial services, retail, healthcare, and technology.   With the recent launch of Sisense Intelligence and the Intelligence Assistant, we are accelerating innovation in embedded analytics, enabling governed, scalable AI experiences that bridge insights to real-time action.   The Role   As a Strategic Customer Success Manager, you will serve as a trusted advisor to mid-sized to large enterprise accounts. You will build deep relationships, drive adoption of our AI-powered platform, maximize value, and fuel retention and expansion. You will collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Product, Engineering, and Support to ensure customers achieve their business goals through clear communication and proactive guidance.   Why Join Our Customer Success Team   This is a strategic, high-impact role where you will own complex accounts, strengthen multi-threaded relationships, and deliver measurable outcomes (NRR, expansion revenue, AI feature adoption). You will work in a collaborative, innovative global environment, partnering with diverse teams to solve real customer challenges and contribute to Sisense's growth in embedded AI analytics.   About You   You thrive in fast-paced, evolving environments, adapting quickly while staying positive and solution-focused. You are a natural relationship builder, skilled at nurturing trusted, multi-level partnerships and positioning yourself as a key advisor. You quickly grasp business goals and technical concepts (including AI/analytics platforms) to align solutions with customer needs. You are proactive and consultative, identifying opportunities, anticipating challenges, and advocating for customers while balancing business priorities. You are collaborative, open to feedback, and passionate about delivering results through continuous learning. Requirements   3–5 years as a Customer Success Manager (or equivalent), with proven success managing enterprise/mid-market accounts (Saa S/BI/analytics preferred). Strong track record driving product adoption, value realization, NRR, and revenue expansion. Excellent presentation and executive communication skills; experience leading EBRs/QBRs and building C-level relationships. Ability to own full account planning, health monitoring, and success strategy across a portfolio. Proactive mindset: identify upsell/cross-sell opportunities, mitigate risks, and deliver measurable ROI. Project management skills to handle complex implementations, onboarding, and technical discussions. Experience collaborating cross-functionally (Sales, Product, Engineering) to resolve issues and influence roadmaps. Exceptional interpersonal, listening, written, and verbal skills (fluent English required; Portuguese a plus). Results-driven with critical thinking, problem-solving, and a customer-centric focus. Comfortable in a dynamic, remote environment managing multiple priorities. Bonus: Background in Business Intelligence (BI), embedded analytics, AI/Gen AI enablement, or similar technical solutions. How You'll Ramp   By Day 30   Complete Customer Success onboarding and training (Sisense values, culture, relationship techniques, product overview, competition, and transformational outcomes). Begin meeting customers, shadowing QBRs/EBRs, and observing how we build relationships and deliver value. By Day 60   Develop strategic account plans for your portfolio and start driving opportunities (adoption, expansion, renewals). Deepen product/technical knowledge through coaching and hands-on work. Fully embed with your accounts and collaborate side-by-side with the team. By Day 90   Own your book of business end-to-end, driving partnership success and measurable results (NRR, adoption, expansion). Master Customer Success best practices, including onboarding, proactive risk management, and AI feature enablement. Become a key contributor to the team's revenue retention and growth goals. What We Offer   Employment through a partner agency (B2 B). Competitive base salary up to USD 3,500 per month (depending on experience). Eligibility for a quarterly performance bonus. Opportunity to work with a global leader in AI-powered embedded analytics. Flexible remote work with a collaborative international team. Professional development and growth opportunities within Customer Success.

Definir, manter e disseminar políticas, padrões e processos relacionados à governança de dados, incluindo: Catalogação, Classificação, Qualidade de dados, Linhagem, Ciclo de vida do dado; Gestão de acessos. Definir e operacionalizar papéis e responsabilidades de governança: Data Owners; Data Stewards e Custodiantes. title: Marketing designer
description:

AI Marketing Designer   Full-time, Remote | US Central Time Business Hours A letter from our client   Our client wanted us to share this role directly in their own words because they're looking for someone exceptional to help them continue growing the right way.   Over the past decade, their agency has grown to support 100+ clients across multiple industries, and they are continuing to scale carefully and intentionally. Maintaining a healthy team culture, avoiding burnout, and delivering high-quality work are major priorities for them.   Their clients range from mission-driven organizations changing lives, to restaurant and hospitality brands, to innovative tech companies building exciting products.   In recent years, the agency has become a trusted partner for businesses that previously had poor experiences with marketing agencies and lost confidence in the process. Their mission is not only to deliver great work, but also to help educate businesses on how modern digital marketing should actually be done.   Why this role exists   Currently, the owner personally handles much of the AI-assisted production work within the agency. This includes designing social media content, building websites, generating content with AI tools, and migrating websites onto a modern development stack.   The systems are working extremely well, allowing the agency to move faster than teams much larger in size. However, he has become the bottleneck.   They are now looking for someone who can take ownership of execution so leadership can focus more heavily on strategy, growth, and client relationships.   The role   This position is equal parts:   AI fluency Design and web development Both skill sets must be strong. On the AI side:   Their ideal candidate actively uses tools like Claude, Chat GPT, and Gemini as part of a daily workflow. They understand prompting for content, imagery, coding, research, and strategy. They see AI as a multiplier for creativity and execution rather than a replacement for skill.   On the design and development side:   The candidate should be able to design professionally in Canva and Photoshop while maintaining brand consistency across multiple industries and aesthetics. They should also feel comfortable building and migrating websites using tools such as Next.js, Vercel, Git Hub, and AI-assisted coding workflows.   The team values people who understand the balance between beautiful design and conversion-focused performance.   Agency experience is strongly preferred, especially for someone familiar with fast turnarounds, proactive communication, and problem-solving before issues escalate.   What the role includes   Designing social media content for multiple brands and industries Building and migrating websites onto modern frameworks Using AI tools to accelerate production workflows Assisting with content creation, research, image generation, and code scaffolding Creating designs that are both visually strong and performance-driven Staying current on new AI tools, workflows, and technologies Collaborating with leadership to improve internal systems and efficiency What our client is looking for   Strong AI workflow experience using tools like Claude, Chat GPT, or Gemini Experience with AI-assisted coding tools Professional Canva and Photoshop skills Comfort using Git Hub, Vercel, and modern web development workflows Basic SEO understanding Strong understanding of social media design across platforms Strong written and spoken English Availability during US Central Time business hours Previous agency experience preferred A highly proactive and self-directed mindset What they DO NOT want   Someone who requires constant follow-up Someone who treats AI as a gimmick or shortcut Someone who forces one design style onto every brand Someone who confuses being busy with being effective Someone unwilling to continuously learn and adapt Portfolio required   Applicants must submit a live portfolio URL with their application.   Their team would like to see:   At least 5 projects A mix of social media and website work At least one live website built end-to-end Optional examples showing how AI supported the workflow What it's like working with them   They work hard, move quickly, and genuinely enjoy what they do. Their culture values humility, creativity, initiative, and excellence.   There is strong room for growth within the company. The person who succeeds in this role will likely have opportunities to expand into leadership and strategy over time.   If this role feels like a fit for you, please apply! They are excited to meet the right person! :)

title: Vendedor (closer) presencial
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Vendedor (closer) presencial em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

Campinas, SP | Vaga Presencial PJ    Sabe aquele filme onde o protagonista encontra o trabalho perfeito? Pois é. Essa é sua audição.    A Like Play Filmes produz conteúdo original para Amazon Prime Video, Vivo Play, Net Now e nossa própria plataforma de streaming. Mas não paramos por aí: criamos o Zero ao Set Plus , um programa que transforma pessoas comuns em atores profissionais com participação GARANTIDA em nossas produções.      E agora precisamos de você para converter sonhadores em estrelas do cinema.      SUA MISSÃ O (CASO ACEITE)      Você vai atender por videochamada pessoas de todo o Brasil que sonham em ser atores. Sua agenda? Já vem prontinha, nosso sistema qualifica e agenda para você. Os leads? Atraidos pelo nosso marketing irresistível. Você só faz o que sabe fazer de melhor: vender.      O produto é simples de entender: formação em atuação para tv e cinema completa + garantia de atuar em produção real. Investimento de um Ticket médio R$3.100. E cada venda? Muda uma vida de verdade.      O QUE VOCÊ GANHA?      Ajuda de custo: Fixo R$36k/ano (R$3.000/mês), Comissões: Somadas vão de 10% a 14% e podem triplicar ou quadruplicar sua renda total (Nossos vendedores top faturam tranquilamente R$8k a R$15k/mês)    Esquema: Seg a sex, horário comercial, presencial em Campinas, mas com flexibilidade REAL pra trabalhar de casa quando precisar.      POR QUE ESSA VAGA É DIFERENTE?      Porque você não vai vender "mais um curso online". Vai vender o momento que uma criança, adolescente ou até mesmo um adulto vai lembrar pro resto da vida. O dia que uma mãe de 35 realizou um sonho antigo. A virada de chave de um jovem que sempre quis, mas nunca soube como. Cada venda sua vira um novo nome nos créditos finais de uma série. Cada contrato fechado pode ser o "antes e depois" de alguém.      E convenhamos: quantos vendedores podem dizer que vão dormir felizes sabendo que ajudaram alguém a aparecer nas telonas do cinema ou streamings?      O QUE VOCÊ PRECISA TER?      Experiência com vendas (de preferência consultivas ou inside sales)    Jogo de cintura pra negociar e fechar por videochamada    Organização pra gerenciar seu funil e bater metas    Comunicação afiada, você vai vender sonhos com método, não papo furado    Vontade de trabalhar numa empresa descolada que está quebrando as regras do mercado tradicional    Diferencial: Conhecimento em CRM e gestão comercial    Essencial: Acreditar que dá pra vender com propósito E ganhar bem fazendo isso      ESTRUTURA QUE FUNCIONA      Aqui você não fica sozinho inventando a roda:   ✓ Sistema de SDR qualifica e monta sua agenda (você não perde tempo prospectando)   ✓ Marketing gera leads quentes (gente que JÁ quer o produto)   ✓ CRM organizado (funil claro, processo definido)   ✓ Produto que vende sozinho (quando a pessoa entende, ela QUER), o maior desafio é a desconfiança. Confiou em você? Contrato fechado....      Seu trabalho é converter. E ganhar bem com isso.      SOBRE NÓ S      Like Play Filmes não é só produtora, é movimento. Já dirigimos mais de 7 mil atores, distribuímos conteúdo em plataformas gigantes e criamos um ecossistema completo pra quem quer viver de audiovisual no Brasil.      Somos a empresa que democratiza o acesso ao cinema. E precisamos de gente que venda isso com a mesma garra que a gente produz.      LUZES, CÂ MERA, CARREIRA!      Se você tem fome de resultado, gosta de desafios e quer trabalhar num lugar onde cada venda realmente importa , essa vaga é sua. Não é só mais um trabalho comum. É a chance de ser lembrado como a pessoa que ajudou alguém a realizar um sonho.      Candidata-se agora e vem fazer parte dessa história.

title: Data engineer
description:

GEA is one of the world’s largest systems suppliers for the food, beverage and pharmaceutical sectors. Our portfolio includes machinery and plants as well as advanced process technology, components and comprehensive services. Used across diverse industries, they enhance the sustainability and efficiency of production processes globally.      We are looking for a Data Engineer      Roles And Responsibilities      Data Architecture & Infrastructure Design and implement a unified data warehouse and/or data lake capable of serving multiple analytics and AI workloads. Define the overall data architecture strategy, including storage layers, access patterns, and scalability approach. Define the data extraction and landing strategy, partitioning and SCD (slowly changing dimensions), data modelling strategy and consumption ports.    Pipeline Development & Integration Build and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines consuming data from multiple enterprise source systems (ERP, CRM, operational tools, and others). Develop pipelines using Databricks (Lakeflow Connect) & Azure Data Factory as primary platforms. Ensure pipeline reliability, scalability, and observability through monitoring, alerting, and logging.    Data Quality & Governance Establish and enforce data quality standards, validation rules, and anomaly detection processes. Implement data cataloguing, lineage tracking, and documentation practices to ensure transparency and auditability. Define naming conventions, schema standards, and access control policies in coordination with stakeholders.    Collaboration & Stakeholder Engagement Work closely with data scientists, BI analysts, and developers within the team to ensure data products meet downstream requirements. Translate business requirements from non-technical stakeholders into robust data models and pipeline logic. Actively contribute to sprint planning and technical decision-making within an agile team environment.    Continuous Improvement Monitor and optimize query performance, pipeline efficiency, and infrastructure cost. Stay current with developments in data engineering tooling, cloud platforms, and best practices. Contribute to the team's knowledge base through documentation and internal knowledge-sharing.    Profile And Qualifications     Minimum 5 years of professional experience in data engineering or a closely related field. Expert-level proficiency in SQL — including complex query design, performance tuning, and schema modeling. Hands-on experience with Databricks for large-scale data processing and pipeline orchestration. Proven experience designing and implementing data warehouse or data lake solutions at enterprise scale. Strong understanding of ETL/ELT design patterns, data modeling methodologies (star schema, data vault, etc.), and pipeline orchestration. Experience integrating data from heterogeneous source systems (ERP platforms, APIs, flat files, operational databases). Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences. Professional-level proficiency in Spanish; working English is a strong advantage.

title: Ai quality analyst (portgugal portuguese )
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Ai quality analyst (portgugal portuguese ) em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

Company Description:   Million Logics is a trusted Oracle Partner and global leader in IT solutions, with operations in London, UK, and a development hub in Hyderabad, India. Specialising in innovative and scalable services, Million Logics empowers enterprises through data & AI, cloud solutions, IT consulting, and custom application development. With a team of 85+ AI/ML experts, we deliver tailored solutions that foster digital transformation and operational excellence. We are committed to client success. We blend world-class technical expertise with strategic insight to deliver results.   Role Overview:   As an AI quality analyst, you will evaluate a new personalisation feature for Gemini. You will assess how well the model uses information from your past Gemini conversations, Gmail, Google Search, and You Tube activity to make responses more relevant and helpful. This role requires a unique blend of creativity and analytical rigour. You will actively design prompts from your personal experiences. You will then use your analytical skills to assess the quality of the model's personalised responses, evaluating dimensions such as grounding, integration, and helpfulness.   Offer Details:   Duration of Contract: 12 months Pay: $1500 per month (net/take-home) Mode of work: Fully Remote Number of Positions: 20 Must have fluency in Portugal Portuguese (not Brazilian Portuguese) Key Qualifications:   Portuguese Proficiency: Ability to read and write in Portugal Portuguese (not Brazilian Portuguese) with a high degree of comp, as Portuguese is the focus language for this project. Personal Account Usage: Willing to use computer science, primary personal Google account (not a testing account), and enable personal data sources for a genuine assessment. Schedule Flexibility: Full-time availability in your local time zone is required. We are staffing a global, 24-hour operations team. Exceptional Analytical Thinking: Demonstrate the ability to evaluate nuanced and ambiguous AI responses, specifically assessing personalisation quality. Creative Prompt Engineering: Experience in designing creative, multi-turn starting prompts based on personal context to thoroughly test the model's capabilities. Strong Evaluation Acumen: Understanding of personalisation concepts, including the ability to identify incorrect personalisation, poor inferences, and forced connections. Meticulous Attention to Detail: The ability to review Side-by-Side (Sx S) model responses and spot subtle differences in naturalness and over-narrating. Excellent Written Communication: Superior ability to write clear, concise, and structured rationales for model rankings, explicitly referencing specific turn numbers. Feedback: Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations. Communication: Excellent communication and collaboration skills. Independence: Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting. Technical Setup: Desktop/laptop set up with a good internet connection. Description:   In this role, you will be part of a dynamic team focused on evaluating the quality of personalised AI interactions. Your day-to-day work will involve: Designing and executing multi-turn conversational prompts (typically 1-5 turns) that require the AI to utilise your personal information and experiences. Evaluating model responses based on your intent from the starting prompt, checking if the personalisation was appropriately applied. Analysing responses for grounding issues, ensuring claims about you are supported by evidence and not flawed inferences or hallucinations. Assessing integration quality to ensure personal data is woven naturally into the response without robotic \"over-narrating\". Rigorously evaluating and stack-ranking two model responses side-by-side (Sx S) to determine which is overall more helpful, easy to use, and enjoyable. Writing clear, defensible rationales for your comparisons, explicitly referencing where issues or positive aspects occurred in the conversation. Extracting and verifying \"Debug Info\" from the model to confirm that chat summaries and data sources were properly utilised. Maintaining strict data hygiene by deleting evaluation conversations to prevent them from polluting your future chat history. Education & Experience:   BS/BA degree or equivalent experience in a relevant field (e.g., policy, law, ethics, linguistics, journalism, computer science, or a related analytical field). Experience in data annotation, AI quality evaluation, content moderation, or a related role is strongly preferred. Additional Details:   Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and up to 40 hours per week, with 4 hours of overlap with PST. Engagement type: Contractor Engagement Length: 12 months

As a Senior Software Engineer, You Will  Own features and systems end-to-end across multiple product surfaces — architecture, implementation, deployment, and iteration Architect and deliver solutions for our Revenue, Revenue Operations, and Business Development teams – including data tools, applications, and agentic orchestrators Serve as a subject matter expert across the whole stack, and report directly to the Chief Architect, who will provide hands-on mentorship in cutting‑edge AI-native development, big data analytics, and cloud infrastructure. Collaborate closely with the Revenue organization, discovering opportunities, projects, and areas to revamp critical business processes with AI Drive initiatives across teams — you’re not waiting for a PM to write a spec; you’re in the room shaping what gets built and why Leverage AI tools like Claude Code, Cursor, Codex to improve personal productivity, ship trustworthy solutions faster through harness engineering, code quality, and documentation. Produce clear documentation: create playbooks, docs, and training materials to institutionalize best practices.   You Are Likely To Succeed If  You have 5+ years of hands-on software development experience with a proven track record of shipping customer-facing applications — and the impact to show for it You are stack-flexible: comfortable working across Python, TypeScript/React, and cloud infrastructure (AWS, Databricks). Opportunities to build a career as a manager or individual contributor through our career ladder that promotes based on impact. You will have regular career conversations with your manager where you will discuss your short and long-term career goals. We are committed to helping you develop in your career and offer the potential for internal mobility opportunities We care about your personal life, and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, a remote-first work environment, flexible vacation, team events, learning reimbursement, and more! Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you make, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust. title: Product Owner
description:

Company Description  Metrobi is a fulfillment platform designed to support local businesses, particularly in industries like food and beverage. The company simplifies delivery management by connecting businesses with local contractor drivers and optimizing in-house delivery operations. Through its logistics, financial, and marketing tools, Metrobi empowers local businesses to confidently grow their distribution networks. Metrobi operates with a mission to enhance efficiency and scale for local makers and distributors. Intro video:  Responsibilities  Backlog & Kanban Management:   Own the Kanban board: organize tasks, ensure priorities are clear and understand what is stopping us from maintaining our task flow to hit our deployment goals. Hiring interviews are online.

title: Senior Software Engineer (Flutter focus)
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Senior Software Engineer (Flutter focus) em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the Company:   Headspace Health is the world’s most accessible and comprehensive digital mental health and wellbeing platform. Headspace Health will democratize mental health and wellbeing so people around the world are supported by a full spectrum of affordable care. In addition to its vast library of mindfulness and meditation content, our behavioral health system offers emotional support, guidance, therapy, and medication from professional coaches, licensed therapists, and psychiatrists, respectively. Our mission is to create a world where mental health is never an obstacle. By harnessing the power and convenience of a smartphone, Headspace Health is able to provide access to high-quality care to anyone, anywhere, in order to reduce symptoms of stress, anxiety, and depression. Role Description:  Headspace is looking for a Senior Software Engineer (Fullstack with Flutter focus) to support our Employer Solutions team. This team builds the foundational capabilities that power our commercial partnerships by enabling hundreds of employers to offer Headspace as a benefit to their workforce. This assignment supports development and delivery of scalable, high-quality mobile systems and features, ensuring they integrate seamlessly with our backend services and bring Headspace’s mission to life. Deliverables:  Design and develop maintainable and flexible services for mission-critical systems that directly support mental healthcare delivery. Collaborate with product and engineering teams to gather requirements and write RFCs and technical specifications to solve technical and business problems end to end. Effectively communicate technical ideas to both technical and non-technical audiences. Use business and technical knowledge to recommend thoughtful tradeoffs between complexity, quality, and delivery speed. Maintain high standards for documentation, code quality, code reviews and operational excellence. Contribute to and influence system architecture decisions, product quality and SLA targets. Apply best practices in testing, monitoring, alerting, and observability.  Requirements:  5+ years of professional software engineering experience. 3+ years of experience developing with Flutter, including familiarity with Flutter frameworks, third-party libraries, and APIs. 2+ years of experience with JavaScript/TypeScript, Node.js, with a strong understanding of design patterns. Proficiency with mobile architecture and design patterns (e.g., MVC, MVVM). Experience designing reliable, scalable microservices architectures. Proficiency with Git version control systems and other essential mobile development tools. Experience writing robust unit, integration, and end-to-end tests, including edge-case handling, using API testing frameworks/tools (e.g., Jest, Gatling, Playwright). Demonstrated ability to deliver in a fast-paced, Agile environment. Demonstrated ability to effectively partner with product managers, designers, and engineers in a remote-friendly environment. Track record of delivering complex projects across product and technology initiatives. Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences and keep stakeholders aligned. BS/MS degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience. Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher).  Nice to have:  Experience with native mobile development (Android and/or iOS), including the respective SDKs and app release workflows. Experience with AWS and working with databases. Experience with SDUI and CI/CD. Experience with flutter_bloc.  Perks:  We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team Health/Sport budget Remote work Flexible PTO Global offices Fun, positive, collaborative environment!  Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

title: Social Media Lead/Community Manager
description:
Empresa está contratando Social Media Lead/Community Manager em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

We’re hiring: Social Lead / Social Media & Community Manager  Earned Media Productions (EMP) is looking for someone who can turn podcasts into growth engines — and build engaged communities around them.  This role sits at the intersection of content distribution, social strategy, and audience engagement.  What you’ll do: • Own daily posting across TikTok, IG Reels, YouTube Shorts, X, and more • Turn podcast episodes into high-performing short-form content • Decide what clips get posted, when, and where • Manage comments, DMs, and community engagement across platforms • Help shape the voice and presence of brands online • Analyze performance and double down on what works Key Responsibilities 1. Content Distribution & Posting Own daily posting across all social platforms (TikTok, IG Reels, YouTube Shorts, X, etc.) Manage scheduling, captions, hashtags, and formatting per platform Ensure consistent, high-volume output of podcast clips  2. Podcast Clip Strategy Turn long-form podcast episodes into a structured content distribution plan  Decide what clips get posted, when, and where  Collaborate with editors to guide clip selection and packaging (hooks, titles, formats)  3. Growth & Optimization Analyze performance data to identify winning formats, topics, and hooks Continuously iterate on posting strategy to increase: Views Engagement Follower growth A/B test captions, formats, and posting times  4. Platform Expertise Stay on top of trends, algorithm changes, and best practices across platforms Adapt content strategy accordingly (e.g., TikTok vs. Reels vs. Shorts nuances)  5. Systems & Organization Build and manage a content calendar + distribution system  Track posted content and performance metrics Ensure no content bottlenecks between editing → posting → reporting  6. Collaboration Work closely with: Editors (to refine clips) Creators/clients (to align on voice and goals) Leadership (to align on growth strategy)  What we’re looking for: • Experience growing social accounts (especially short-form video) • Strong understanding of TikTok / Reels / Shorts • Someone who actually gets internet culture + audience behavior • Ability to manage both content output + community interaction  Must-Haves 2–4+ years managing social media accounts (preferably podcast or creator-led content) Proven experience growing accounts through short-form video  Deep understanding of TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts Strong instincts for what makes content go viral  Experience managing high-volume posting (multiple posts/day) Fluent in English - Speaking and Writing.   Nice-to-Haves Experience working with podcasts or long-form content Background in content editing or scripting Familiarity with tools like: Asana/ Slack Social schedulers (Later, Hootsuite, etc.) Analytics tools Experience managing multiple brands or clients  Bonus: • Experience with podcasts or creator-led brands • Background in content editing or scripting • Experience building or managing online communities This is a high-impact role with real ownership across content, distribution, and community.
